mission: Investigate whether GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravity measurements and groundwater-well observations independently establish aquifer depletion in the High Plains and California Central Valley. Compare matched spatial regions, observation periods, storage estimates, aquifer-specific yield, vadose-zone contributions, hydrologic-model dependencies, spatial-resolution limitations, and uncertainties. Distinguish direct observations from model-derived groundwater estimates, shared inputs, and genuine independent corroboration. Preserve disagreements and unresolved evidence. Discovery only; no canonical assertions, taxonomy decisions, reviews, or publication.
